name: 07-glass-toast
prompt: Macro shot of four crystal wine glasses gently clinking above a black marble table, red wine catching pink and gold rim light, droplets in the air, candle bokeh. Cinematic, luxury, high-end corporate film. Deep black and charcoal palette, with subtle hot pink (#FF1FA9) and warm gold-yellow (#FCD500) neon rim light and soft neon glow rings. Shallow depth of field, anamorphic lens flares, rich shadows, filmic grain. No on-screen text, no logos, no watermarks.
